description: §21.3.1 / §22.13 — the clean twin: a plain file-top `import { ... } from "./helpers.scrml"` in a project with no manifest is NOT gated. E-IMPORT-008 constrains `import:host` only.
rationale: §21.3.1 / §22.13 gate the `import:host` declaration form. A plain `import` of a scrml module is the canonical adopter path and never consults `[capabilities] host-import`, so with the manifest absent ("disabled") it still compiles clean.
